# Wordle Game

> A free, full-stack Wordle hub: daily and unlimited word puzzles, word-length
> variants (4-11 letters), custom shareable words, real-time multiplayer,
> spin-off games (Sedecordle, Connect, Squares), a solver, and a daily archive.
> Available in 13 languages. No account or sign-in required.

## How to play

Guess the hidden word within six tries. After each guess, tiles are colored:
green (correct letter, correct position), yellow (correct letter, wrong
position), and gray (letter not in the word).

## Game modes

- [Daily Wordle](/en): one shared 5-letter puzzle per day.
- [Unlimited](/en/unlimited): endless random puzzles, no daily limit.
- [Word lengths](/en/5-letters): variants from 4 to 11 letters (e.g. /en/7-letters).
- [Custom](/en/custom): create your own word and share a link.
- [Multiplayer](/en/multiplayer): create or join a room and race friends in real time.
- [Sedecordle](/en/sedecordle): solve 16 boards at once in 21 guesses.
- [Connect](/en/connect): group 16 words into 4 hidden categories.
- [Squares](/en/squares): find words in a 4x4 letter grid.
- [Solver](/en/solver): enter green/yellow/gray clues to find possible answers.
- [Archive](/en/archive): replay past daily puzzles.
